column1: # Princess Peach: Showtime! 1.0.0, Good-Feel / Unreal Engine 4.27 with Nintendo's NVN RHI, Wwise, SDK 15.3.2. Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents)
# nninitStartup reserves one address region for the engine, 62 GB by default; the rewriter's engine-wide gate on the store of its size (dm/tools/ue_region.py; hle_svc.c)
# gives it what the alias region has room for (2.81 GB). FMallocBinned3's pool reservation is replaced by the host's malloc zone (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py; hle_uemalloc.c).
# The layout of the other Unreal games with virtual address memory: it needs no extended address space on an iPhone
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# The Switch build sets rhi.SyncInterval 2 (30 fps). hle_fpslock.c lowers it, found by name by the rewriter (ue_cvar.py); the game's movement is time-based. DM_FPS_TARGET=30 restores 30
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
